summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, unzips it, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line file exhibiting string-array/rotation obfuscation (rotating string-array function, hex-mangled identifiers, custom base64-like decoder) and is executed automatically on npm install via the alien Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. The package advertises itself as a Kendo React grid wrapper under the @servicetitan scope, a purpose that does not require a second language runtime or an opaque install-time payload. A dist/ tree containing plausible grid source ships alongside the dropper, consistent with a trojanized impersonation of a ServiceTitan-scoped grid module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
